### The Pleasing Aroma
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pleasing-aroma
Passage: Genesis 8:21
Points:
- After leaving the ark, Noah offered clean animals in thankful worship for God's deliverance.
- Human nature remained fallen after the flood, requiring God's holiness and His gracious covenant promises to be reconciled.
- Pleased by the soothing aroma of the offering, God pledged never again to destroy all living creatures.
- Noah's temporary sacrifice points forward to Jesus Christ, whose sacrifice permanently turns away God's wrath for His people.
- Believers are challenged to worship the Savior with deep gratitude rather than taking His salvation for granted.
